decisions.reason: All candidates pass the frozen gates. Candidate 01 best preserves source clustering while keeping nucleus count and nearest-neighbor spacing close to source and achieving a strong local-population score.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 49,934-pixel joint change forms localized coherent expansion along authorized tumor-stroma interfaces; its 45,527-pixel tissue component preserves neighboring non-target structures.
decisions.nucleus_layout: The 38 placed nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative area-p95, count, NND and Ripley ratios are 0.733, 1.022, 0.983 and 1.005, with sampling score 0.916.
decisions.coupling: Added nuclei occupy the authorized tumor expansion; quota, seam, compatibility, spatial-distribution and density checks pass.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged without partial-instance, overlap, border or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: Target nuclei are smaller than the source reference but remain inside the frozen envelope. Mask-only evidence does not establish generated-H&E quality or clinical validity.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 01 as the single mask-condition handoff.
